name: Baked falafel plate
steps: Blitz the chickpeas with garlic, cumin, parsley and salt into a coarse paste.
Shape the mixture into small patties.
Brush the patties with olive oil and bake until golden.
Warm the pita and cut into wedges.
Plate the falafel with tomato and a drizzle of tahini.
Scatter over chopped parsley to serve.
